scope: P3 repeated 16K point diagnosis, not a full runtime curve

acceptance.performance: report all session medians, ranges and prediction errors; no statistical significance or production threshold inferred

limitations: Only two measured prompt families; repeat sessions share prompts/KV files
Validation is temporal, not held-out content
No fitted curve will be installed from a single 16K point
Diagnostic logprobs excluded from latency fitting
stop: Any correctness/budget failure stops qualification; no outlier filtering
